title: The battlefield changes when the Guru is with you
summary: This meets the frightened feeling that life has become one long contest. The line says victory comes through the Perfect Guru, not through panic's private weapons.
takeaway: Enter the battle with the Guru, not panic.
lifeApplication: Before the appointment, confrontation, or sleepless spiral, place both feet on the floor and say the line once. Let companionship arrive before the mind starts fighting shadows.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru turns life's hard field into a place of victory.
source.lifeApplication: When fear makes life feel combative, ask for the Guru's nearness before reacting.

evidence.coreClaim: The Guru turns life's hard field into a place of victory.
evidence.turn: Fear thins when shelter becomes personal again.
